annotations.title: Portfolio / watchlist review: up to 25 US stocks in one call (SEC filings)

description: Use when someone shares a list of stocks they hold or watch and asks "how healthy is this portfolio?", "what should I look at first?" or "which of these report next?". tickers = comma list (1-25), weights = optional numbers in the same order. Returns per-holding quality score, growth, margins, free cash flow, net cash, dilution and red flags with severity; portfolio-weighted quality, growth and margins; share of weight in loss-makers, negative FCF, net debt; concentration; a review-first list ranked by weight x flag severity; strongest holdings; an estimated reporting calendar; CSV. Charged only if covered holdings carry >= 50% of the weight. Counts as 10 calls on a Research Pass. Research only, no recommendations. PAID: $1.00 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Research Pass (header Authorization: Bearer lp1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/equity/portfolio.

tickers.description: Comma-separated US tickers or SEC CIKs, 1-25 (e.g. AAPL,MSFT,KO,TSLA). Default: AAPL,MSFT,GOOGL,META,AVGO,JNJ,KO,TSLA,UNH,WMT

weights.description: Optional weights in the same order as tickers (position values, percents or any positive scale; normalised to 100%). Default equal weight
